title: Visually Refined
description: Visually Refined is a lightweight Fabric modpack that improves Minecraft's visuals, atmosphere, performance, and immersion while preserving the vanilla experience, without adding new content or changing gameplay.
body:
## Visually Refined

Visually Refined is a Minecraft modpack focused on improving the vanilla experience with better visuals, animations, atmosphere, and performance optimizations.

The goal of this modpack is to make Minecraft look more polished and immersive while keeping the game smooth and accessible. Instead of adding new content, mechanics, or changing the way Minecraft is played, Visually Refined focuses on refining the experience you already know.

Unlike many visual-focused modpacks that heavily impact performance, this modpack combines lightweight graphical improvements with optimization mods to achieve a balance between visual quality and FPS.

### Features
🎨 Visual Enhancements
- Improved entity models and textures
- Better animations for mobs and the player
- Connected textures and visual improvements
- Enhanced particles and environmental effects
- Shader support with lightweight options

⚡ Performance Improvements
- Optimized rendering and chunk loading
- Reduced memory usage
- FPS and stability improvements
- Designed to provide better performance while keeping visual quality

🌎 Immersive Vanilla Experience
- Dynamic ambient sounds
- Improved sound experience
- More detailed environments
- Small visual improvements that make the world feel more alive

⚙️ Quality of Life Improvements
- Better information displays
- Improved interfaces
- Vanilla-friendly enhancements

---

⚠️ Note

This modpack is still in development. Since this is my first modpack project, some bugs or issues may occur. Feedback is appreciated and helps improve future updates :)
